benchmark_type_evidence: We present BELEBELE, a multiple-choice machine reading comprehension (MRC) dataset spanning 122 language variants.
brief_description: A fully parallel multiple-choice machine reading comprehension (MRC) benchmark spanning 122 language variants across 29 scripts and 27 language families, with 900 questions based on passages from the FLORES-200 dataset. Questions were created in English and professionally translated to all target languages.
